answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy enforces a quadratic stake-burning mechanism scaled by global network presence. For an attacker spawning n identities, the cumulative burning cost scales as O(n^2), imposing superlinear economic friction. Like an immutable tide that drowning adversaries cannot stem, this burns scarce tokens permanently on-chain. Counterfeit nodes cannot wander unbonded through consensus, as each requires heavy, ferrous collateral locks.
